parameters.query:
SELECT vn.* FROM vehicle_notifications vn
JOIN organizations o ON vn.organization_id = o.id
WHERE DATE(vn."notificationDate") = CURRENT_DATE
AND vn.status = 'imported'
AND vn."emailSentAt" is null
AND vn."smsSentAt" is null
AND vn."deleted_at" is null
AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (o.free_trial_end_date IS NULL OR o.free_trial_end_date > NOW());
